prompt: Original OpenFA strategy game UI panel skin, matching our original supporting menu's weathered teal/graphite metal and restrained copper/amber fittings. No text, letters, numbers, logos, icons, buttons, lights across content area, no objects, no scenery. Fully opaque dark panel. A new independent design, do not reproduce Fragile Allegiance pixels or exact UI. Source to be cut as nine-slice frame preserving consistent corner size.
